Nobody likes explaining it twice.

This first prototype follows one washer repair: report the leak, find a coverage gap, prepare a message, hand off to Alex, and confirm the outcome.

Suggested replies drive a scripted conversation. Typed messages support the same repair scenario. Facts and the timeline persist in this browser; this is not a live Alexa integration or an AI service.
